units.source_text: 对柏木说道：“抱歉得很，我很胆怯，写不好诗，请你替我修改吧。”

en.t: He said to Kashiwagi, "I am terribly sorry, but I am timid and cannot write a good poem. Please revise it for me."

units.source_text: 柏木答道：“不必写诗，我陪你同去就是了。”

en.t: Kashiwagi replied, "There is no need to write a poem. I will simply go with you."

units.source_text: 夕雾说笑道：“你这种随从我不要！”

en.t: Yugiri joked, "I do not need an attendant like you!"

units.source_text: 便叫柏木拿了回信先回家去。

en.t: Then he had Kashiwagi take the reply letter and go home ahead of him.
